name: Dreams Catamaran Cruises
summary: A small catamaran company sailing from Wharf Road in Bridgetown, started in 2021 by Shakir Greaves. Shared cruises take 10 to 20 guests on a boat certified for about 30, with snorkel stops for turtles and shipwrecks along the west coast. Food, an open bar and snorkel gear come with every cruise.
standouts: Sails with 10 to 20 guests on a catamaran certified for about 30
Fountaine Pajot Athena 38 sailing catamaran, 38 ft, crew of 3
Hotel, airport and cruise port pickup offered

trips.title: The Lunch Cruise
trips.summary: A five hour catamaran day along the west coast with two snorkel stops, one at Carlisle Bay for turtles and shipwrecks and one near Holetown. A family-style Bajan lunch and an open bar are served on board, and the crew guide each snorkel stop from the water.
highlights: Stops at Carlisle Bay and Holetown
Family-style Bajan lunch and open bar
trips.departsFrom: Dreams Catamaran Cruises, The Wharf Rd, Bridgetown, beside the Chamberlain Bridge
includes: Unlimited rum punch, cocktails, wine, beers and soft drinks
Bajan buffet with fresh fish, chicken and local sides
Masks, snorkels, floating noodles and safety jackets
Hotel, airport and cruise port pickup offered
trips.checkNotes: Currency not stated, shown as $. The cruise page tile, the lunch cruise page and the checkout all show $120; the comparison table on /cruises says $110 and up. Used $120. The FAQ says cruises leave from the Shallow Draught Harbour, but the meeting point text says Wharf Road beside the Chamberlain Bridge; used the meeting point. The checkout is a request form that says 'Payment on agreement'.

trips.title: Sunset Cruise
trips.summary: An afternoon catamaran trip that leaves Bridgetown at 2:45 pm, with turtle snorkelling and dinner on board as the sun sets. A family-style Bajan dinner and an open bar are included.
highlights: Family-style Bajan dinner and open bar
trips.departsFrom: Dreams Catamaran Cruises, The Wharf Rd, Bridgetown, beside the Chamberlain Bridge
includes: Unlimited rum punch, cocktails, wine, beers and soft drinks
Masks, snorkels, floating noodles and safety jackets
Hotel, airport and cruise port pickup offered
bring: A light jacket or long sleeves for the evening
trips.checkNotes: Currency not stated, shown as $. Called 'The Afternoon Cruise' in the comparison table on /cruises. The Sunset Cruise page itself repeats the lunch cruise details (5 hours, 9:00 AM, Bajan lunch), which look copied in error; duration, departure time and meal taken from the comparison table on /cruises. The 'Book Sunset Cruise' button on /cruises opens a checkout for 'afternoon-cruise' that prices at $120; the checkout reached from the Sunset Cruise page prices at $100. Used the $100 shown on the tile, the trip page and that checkout.

trips.title: Private Charters
trips.summary: The whole catamaran for your own group, with the itinerary, timing and catering arranged to suit. A dedicated captain and crew sail with you.
highlights: Whole boat for your private party
trips.departsFrom: Dreams Catamaran Cruises, The Wharf Rd, Bridgetown, beside the Chamberlain Bridge
trips.checkNotes: Currency not stated, shown as $. Enquiry only, through the contact form at https://dreamscatamaranbarbados.com/contact?cruise=private-charters&name=Private+Charters. Price is per charter, not per person.

checkNotes: Prices show only '$' and never name the dollar. The home page carries Viator-style badges (free cancellation up to 24 hours before, reserve now and pay later, lowest price guarantee); not recorded as operator terms. The '6,500+ reviews on TripAdvisor' link on /cruises points to a TripAdvisor page for Silver Moon Charters, a different business, so that review count was not used.
